hatA11y: Party hat. Open the birthday card

dog.title: Happy birthday, pup!
dog.age: Your pup is 1 year old today.
dog.cake: The cake is a dog-safe treat: no chocolate, no sweets.
dog.tip: Chocolate is poisonous to dogs. It contains theobromine, and the darker the chocolate, the more dangerous it is.

cat.title: Happy birthday, kitty!
cat.age: Your kitty is 1 year old today.
cat.cake: The cake is a cat-safe treat: no chocolate, no milk.
cat.tip: Milk is not a treat for a grown-up cat: adult cats can't digest it well, and it can upset their tummy. Chocolate is poisonous to cats too.
